notes: The UE3310 is a single active USB extension cable (10 m / 32.8 ft), not a boxed rack/desktop unit — it has an integrated USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-A male connector on one end (upstream, to host) and a USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-A female connector on the other end (downstream, to device), plus a separate 16 cm USB extension pigtail included in the box. It ships with an external AC power adapter that plugs into the cable via a DC barrel connector; exact barrel voltage/amperage is not published on the manufacturer page or retailer spec tables (Markertek, B&H listing), so the dc-barrel port grade/spec is inferred from ATEN's standard UE-series design rather than confirmed. Daisy-chainable up to ~50 m total. No rack unit size applies (not rack-mountable).
